zh-CN.title: 方案对比
zh-CN.goal: 让标准、取舍和建议可检查，适合工具选型、采购或方案评审。

optionalInputs.question: 要解决什么问题，候选方案有哪些？
最看重哪些标准或不可妥协的约束？
预算、时间和维护成本有哪些已知信息？
有哪些报价、实测或资料来源？

qualityChecks: 采用同维度对照表，明确单位、时间与未知项。
有可信数据时才增加权重或成本计算器，并展示计算方法。
不把缺失数据当作零分；调整权重时推荐结论必须同步更新。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Option comparison
en.goal: Make criteria, tradeoffs and recommendations inspectable for selection or review.

optionalInputs.question: What decision is needed and which options are being considered?
Which criteria and hard constraints matter most?
What is known about budget, time and maintenance cost?
Which quotes, measurements or sources can be cited?

qualityChecks: Compare matching dimensions with explicit units, dates and unknown values.
Add weighting or cost calculators only when supported by credible data; expose the method.
Missing evidence is not a zero score; changing weights must update recommendations.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
